title: IVG Pro Salts Blueberry Watermelon Cherry 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Pro Nic Salts Blueberry Watermelon Cherry 10ml E-Liquid delivers a highly layered and exceptionally juicy fruit vaping experience. The inhale introduces a smooth blend of dark, rich Blueberry and the light, refreshing crispness of Watermelon. As the flavour develops, a bold note of sweet Cherry emerges on the exhale, completing this dynamic trio with a rich and vibrant finish that offers something new with every draw. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. IVG Pro Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits, serving as a highly cost-effective alternative to single-use or prefilled systems. The IVG Pro Salts collection takes the globally revered flavour profiles from the beloved IVG Pro prefilled pod range and makes them available in convenient 10ml bottles. As a multi-award-winning UK brand, IVG ensures exceptional quality across a massive selection of e-liquids. Beyond the complex fruit layers of Blueberry Watermelon Cherry, vapers can explore other standout blends such as the crisp Spearmint or the candy-inspired Raspberry Blast, ensuring a premium option for every palate.
